data.name: Emalee
data.gender_notes: Emalee is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Old English 'Ema' meaning 'universal' and 'lee' meaning 'tree' or 'leaf'. This name represents the strength and adaptability of a tree, with the universal love and nurturing qualities of 'Ema'. The name Emalee carries the meaning “Ema's leaf” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Emalee usually hope their child will grow to embody ema's leaf and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_hebrew.name: אמלי
in_hebrew.meaning: אמלי היא שם שפירושו אם היא אלוהים
in_hebrew.long_meaning: אמלי הוא שם שמקורו בשפה העברית ופירושו 'אם היא אלוהים' או 'אלוהים היא אמי'. השם נגזר מהמילים 'אם' (אֵם) ו-'אלוהים' (אלוקים). הוא משמש לעתים קרובות כביטוי של יראת כבוד ומסירות לאלוהים. השם אמלי מופיע בתרבויות שונות ומשויך לאיכויות של אמהות, חמלה ודבקות.

in_greek.name: Εμαλη
in_greek.meaning: Το Εμαλη σημαίνει Θεομήτωρ ή Μητέρα του Θεού
in_greek.long_meaning: Το Εμαλη είναι όνομα που προέρχεται από τις ελληνικές λέξεις 'Θεομήτωρ' (Theotokos) ή 'Μητέρα του Θεού'. Αυτό το όνομα έχει βαθιά πνευματική σημασία και συνδέεται με τον σεβασμό και την προσκύνηση προς την Παναγία, τη μητέρα του Ιησού Χριστού. Στην παράδοση της Ανατολικής Ορθόδοξης Εκκλησίας, το όνομα Εμαλη αντανακλά την πίστη και την αφοσίωση στο Θεό.

in_latin.name: Emalee
in_latin.meaning: Emalee means God is my mother or Mother of God
in_latin.long_meaning: The name Emalee originates from the combination of 'Deus' (God) and 'mater' (mother). It signifies a profound spiritual relationship with God, often expressed as 'God is my mother' or 'Mother of God'. This name has been used in Christian traditions to denote a deep sense of devotion, reverence, and filial love towards God. Historically, it reflects the early Christian practice of addressing God with familial terms.

in_english.name: Emalee
in_english.meaning: Emalee means God is my mother or a variant of Immanuel
in_english.long_meaning: The name Emalee is derived from Hebrew roots, combining 'Em' (mother) and 'El' (God), thus meaning 'God is my mother' or 'Mother of God'. It shares etymological similarities with the name Immanuel, meaning 'God with us'. Emalee has been adopted in Christian cultures to signify a personal and intimate relationship with God, embodying qualities of maternal love, compassion, and divine presence. The name has been used across various Christian denominations, symbolizing faith, devotion, and spiritual connection.
